title: 第19章 砍菜切瓜第20章 此宝与我有缘
content_zh:
经过一番修整，楚墨一行人继续朝朱鸣所言的部落痕迹方向继续进发。
越往东南方向靠近，环境越是诡异，参天古木逐渐被扭曲怪异的植物替代，地面时不时可见大型物体被拖拽的痕迹。
“等一下。”楚墨叫住众人，俯身扫开地面落叶，一只清晰的脚印映入眼帘。
“是人类活动的痕迹。”赢乐兴奋起来，“估计那些土著就在不远处。”
朱鸣下意识掐紧手中风盾符，提醒道：“都小心一些。”
虽然他嘴上说不将土著放在眼中，但是没真正见到对方手段，心中多少有些忐忑。
众人提高警惕，又前行了约莫半个时辰，一处简陋的营地出现在视野尽头。
“那是我们的人！”苏瑶惊呼一声，指向营地中央。
只见三具度厄弟子的尸体，孤零零的挂在长矛上，营地空荡荡的，不见半个人影。
赢乐仔细观察四周，确认没有埋伏后，叹了口气：“我们来晚一步，这里的土著已经跑了。”又没抓到人，自己的灵债可怎么办啊？
朱鸣上前检查尸体，讶然道：“居然有两具是修炼《万象宝身诀》的。看来这群土著中，至少有一名中级勇士。”
说着，他便动手将尸体取下。
“朱兄，你这是干什么？”赢乐不解，对方何时有了替人收尸的闲心。
“咳咳，”朱鸣神色略带尴尬，“主修宝身诀的肉身，在宗门善功堂回收价格不低。
我不像赢师弟一样家底丰厚，反正他们魂魄已入洞景幡，这身皮囊不如让我补充一下家用。”
张猛闻言瞪大眼睛，看着他利落将尸体塞入储物袋的动作，打了个寒颤。
“都是同门，接济一次我咋了？我度厄仙宗向来提倡弟子之间，应同心协力，共渡大道。”朱鸣振振有词地辩解道。
“你们看这。”楚墨出声打断几人，指着一处被踩踏的草丛和破碎陶片，“痕迹很新，他们没走多远。”
赢乐面色一肃，急忙说道：“赶紧追，说不定还能赶上对方。”
众人对视点头，朝着痕迹延伸方向急速追去。

......
山谷深处，大约二三十个图腾勇士正朝东南方向迁徙，他们穿着简陋兽皮，神情警惕。
首领不断环顾四周，时不时出言催促大家抓紧速度。明明已经走出不远的路程，他心中那抹不安却愈发。
“快！再快一点！穿过这个山谷就好了！”首领忍不住再次催促。
就在此时，异变突生。
“嗖——！”
一道赤芒伴随着刺耳的破空声，朝他眼睛飞袭而来。首领瞳孔骤缩，怒吼一声，一只面目狰狞的磐石巨彘虚影瞬间罩住身体。
“当——”
赤芒撞在虚影上，发出震耳轰鸣。这时他才看清赤芒的真面目——一只火焰缠绕的羽箭。
“嗖——嗖——！”
不等他喘息，又是两道灼热赤芒破空而来，角度刁钻，直取要害！
content_en:
After some repairs, Chu Mo and his party continued to move in the direction of the tribal traces mentioned by Zhu Ming.
The closer you get to the southeast, the weirder the environment becomes. Towering ancient trees are gradually replaced by twisted and weird plants, and traces of large objects being dragged can be seen on the ground from time to time.
"Wait a minute." Chu Mo stopped everyone, leaned over and swept away the fallen leaves on the ground, and a clear footprint came into view.
"It's traces of human activities." Ying Le became excited, "I guess those indigenous people are not far away."
Zhu Ming subconsciously tightened the Wind Shield Talisman in his hand and reminded: "Be careful."
Although he said he didn't take the natives seriously, he didn't really see the other party's methods, so he felt a little uneasy.
Everyone increased their vigilance and walked forward for about half an hour before a simple camp appeared at the end of their field of vision.
"That's our person!" Su Yao exclaimed and pointed to the center of the camp.
Only the corpses of three Due disciples were seen, hanging alone on spears. The camp was empty, with not a single person in sight.
Ying Le looked around carefully and after confirming that there was no ambush, he sighed: "We are a step too late. The natives here have already escaped." If no one was caught, what would he do with his spiritual debt?
Zhu Ming stepped forward to inspect the corpses and said in surprise: "There are actually two who practice the "All-Seeing Treasure Body Art". It seems that there is at least one intermediate warrior among this group of natives."
With that said, he started to remove the body.
"Brother Zhu, what are you doing?" Ying Le wondered when the other party had the leisure to collect corpses for others.
"Ahem," Zhu Ming looked slightly embarrassed, "The physical body that majors in the Treasure Body Jue can be recycled at the Zongmen Shanggong Hall for a high price.
I don't have a rich family like Junior Brother Ying. Anyway, their souls have already entered the Dongjing Banner. It's better to let me supplement the family income. "
Zhang Meng's eyes widened when he heard this, and he shuddered as he watched him neatly stuff the body into the storage bag.
"We are all from the same sect, what's wrong with helping me once? Our Du'e Immortal Sect has always advocated that disciples should work together to cross the road together." Zhu Ming argued plausibly.
"Look at this." Chu Mo interrupted a few people and pointed to a trampled grass and broken pottery fragments. "The traces are very new. They didn't go far."
Ying Le looked solemn and said hurriedly: "Hurry up and chase, maybe you can catch up with him."
Everyone looked at each other and nodded, quickly chasing in the direction where the traces extended.
...
Deep in the valley, about twenty or thirty totem warriors were migrating toward the southeast. They wore simple animal skins and looked alert.
The leader kept looking around, urging everyone to hurry up. Although he had already walked a short distance, the uneasiness in his heart became more and more intense.
"Hurry! Hurry up! Just cross this valley!" The leader couldn't help but urge again.
At this moment, a sudden change occurred.
“Whoosh——!”
A ray of red light flew towards his eyes accompanied by a harsh sound of breaking through the air. The leader's pupils shrank suddenly and he roared angrily. The shadow of a ferocious rock giant pig instantly covered his body.
"When——"
The red light hit the shadow, making an ear-splitting roar. Only then did he see the true face of Chimang - an arrow wrapped in flames.
"Whoosh-whoosh-!"
Before he could take a breath, two more scorching red lights came through the air, at a tricky angle, hitting his vital point!
